fair_value.method: Sum of the parts on ~3.95B shares: core auto (~$80B rev, ~5% op margin, 30x EBIT-ish) ~$150B + energy (~$15B rev growing 30-40%, ~20% margin) ~$110B + FSD software (1.48M subs) ~$60B + net cash ~$27B = ~$350B (~$90/sh), plus probability-weighted optionality: robotaxi ~$550B (roughly 25-30% chance of a multi-trillion outcome) and Optimus ~$280B, total ~$1.18T = ~$300/sh. Cross-check: 2027 EPS ~$2.3-2.5 x 120-130x = ~$290-320.

bear.story: Capex >$25B/yr keeps FCF negative, auto op margin stays ~1-4%, deliveries flat-to-down (Q3 consensus 461k vs 497k last year), NHTSA Cybercab audit and slow unsupervised FSD rollout push robotaxi scale out; multiple compresses toward 90-100x on ~$2.3 EPS.

base.story: Steady but unspectacular progress: robotaxi expands to ~12+ metros, Cybercab production ramps slowly, EU FSD supervised approval, energy grows, margins recover modestly; narrative premium holds roughly where it is and stock ends near today's level.

bull.story: Unsupervised FSD on customer cars and a visible Cybercab ramp (tens of thousands of units) make robotaxi economics credible; Optimus demos + possible SpaceX/xAI combination rerate the stock above the prior $498 high.

thesis_break_reason: About 12% below the 52-week low ($297) and ~30% below today; with nearly all of the ~$1.47T market cap resting on autonomy/robotics optionality, a sustained move there would most likely reflect a fundamental failure (robotaxi halted or recalled after the NHTSA audit or a serious crash, unsupervised FSD slipping another year, auto gross margin collapse, or a value-destructive Musk related-party deal) rather than ordinary 46%-vol noise.

Duration of negative FCF from >$25B capex versus core auto margin recovery
Vehicle demand: 2026 deliveries tracking flat/down, Chinese competition

Macro/rate and AI-trade sentiment given beta ~1.8
reasoning: Evidence: Q2 2026 revenue $28.2B (+26%) with record 480k deliveries, but op margin 1.4%, non-GAAP EPS $0.33 (miss), capex $5.8B and FCF -$1.1B; 2026 capex guided >$25B and rising for 2-3 years; $43.5B cash, ~$27B net cash. TTM EPS $1.08, forward P/E ~195, market cap ~$1.47T on 3.95B shares. Stock is ~25-30% below its Dec-2025 peak ($498.83), fell 6% after an underwhelming Sept 3 Cybercab launch plus an NHTSA audit; robotaxi runs in 6-7 metros with ~550 vehicles in Texas. Analysts: mean PT $397, median $415, range $125-$600, 20 of 43 at Hold. My SOTP fair value (~$300) sits below the price because I only partly credit robotaxi/Optimus, but TSLA has persistently traded at a large narrative premium, so I do not expect convergence to fair value in 12 months; I blend fundamental drag (slight negative drift) with the stock's historical positive drift and analyst targets, giving a median ~$365 (slightly below spot). Dispersion: lognormal with sigma ~0.50 (a bit above the 46% realized vol to reflect binary catalysts: FSD approvals, NHTSA outcome, possible SpaceX merger), with slightly fattened tails. Scenario mix 25/50/25 at $230/$370/$580 gives mean ~$388, consistent with the ladder. Research used ~12 web searches/fetches; two sources (CNBC, Forbes) blocked, so relied on syndicated summaries. No option data consulted.
